findings.reason: without a space-separated-pair case the gate cannot fail on the one regression its own deliverable sentence creates, so the node can land a reader that silently drops commits.
findings.text: §25's done-when fixes four forms (sha-subject list items, a JSON list of sha-subject strings, a bare list item stating none, a comma-separated line) plus a fifth refusal case, and none of them is the space-separated pair the deliverable names; at the base revision `commits: <sha> <sha>` already parses to two commits while `commits: <sha> fix(crew): something` parses to one entry carrying the subject, so a reader that keeps the first token as the sha and treats the rest as its subject truncates a base-correct space-separated pair and still passes every case
